resources.string: Choose up to four apps in order. The last app stays in front. Tap Run to open the sequence.
This space is yours. Hold an app in the index to place it here.
A small control above other apps. Tap for music; hold for ARC and FLOW. Optional, on this device only.

Android grants media-session access through notification access. This is a broad system permission. Intelia uses playback metadata and controls; it does not read, save or send message notifications. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
